name: Home on the Range
summary: At Talrendis Point, Berdun Cliffbrew offers you free lodging if you bring hides to repair his travel lodge tent. He needs Mosshoof Hides from Azshara.

sections.title: A Place to Stay
sections.body: Berdun Cliffbrew’s travel lodge at Talrendis Point needs repairs. He offers you a free stay if you bring him Mosshoof Hides for the tent. The easiest Mosshooves to hunt are north of the lodge, though hides from any Mosshoof will do.

faq.answer: Berdun Cliffbrew needs Mosshoof Hides to repair his travel lodge tent at Talrendis Point.
Berdun offers you free lodging at his travel lodge if you bring him the hides he needs to repair the tent.

faq.q: Where can I find Mosshoof Hides?
faq.answer: Berdun says the easiest Mosshooves to hunt are just north of Talrendis Point, but hides from any Mosshoof will do.

faq.q: How many hides does Berdun need?
